reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: accrue_interest has multiple non-test callers in reserve.move, market.move, obligation.move, debt.move — not dead code. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in scope; attack entry point is public user-facing borrow endpoint (untrusted). Gate 3: reserve.move is explicitly in scope. Code confirms the proof trace at L143 (cash_reserve grows unboundedly via reserve_factor*interest) and L313 (assert cash >= cash_reserve.ceil() in withdraw_underlying with no guard in accrue_interest). An attacker can trigger this via the public borrow endpoint by borrowing to near-maximum utilization (leaving minimal cash), causing subsequent accrue_interest calls to push cash_reserve above cash, permanently aborting all withdraw_underlying calls and DoS-ing depositor withdrawals and liquidations until borrowers voluntarily repay.
